name: genpark-agent-cryptographic-audit-trail-merkle-sealer-skill
description: Agent cryptographic audit trail Merkle sealer with tamper-evident SHA-256 tree generation, logarithmic inclusion proofs, and verifiable integrity checks.

tools.name: record_event
tools.description: Append an agent interaction or tool call to the Merkle audit trail.

tools.name: compute_merkle_root
tools.description: Compute the current cryptographic root hash of all recorded events.

tools.name: generate_inclusion_proof
tools.description: Generate a cryptographic audit proof path for a specific event.

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Verify an inclusion proof against an expected Merkle root.
